cases.title: Literature-only evidence summary
cases.prompt: Summarize the published evidence for the ketogenic diet in children with drug-resistant epilepsy.
answer_must: Every study or paper discussed carries a PMID.
answer_must_not: Presents numbers or study names that do not appear in the search results.

cases.title: Currently recruiting trials
cases.prompt: Which trials of pembrolizumab in non-small cell lung cancer are currently recruiting?
answer_must: Each trial is identified by its NCT ID.
States that the list may be incomplete if the number returned equals the number requested.

cases.title: UK trial registry question
cases.prompt: Are there UK-registered trials of cognitive behavioural therapy for insomnia in adolescents?
answer_must: Any trial named carries an ISRCTN ID taken from search results.
If nothing relevant is found, says so and lists what was searched.
answer_must_not: Names a trial without an identifier from the search results.

cases.title: Multi-step evidence review with cross-referencing
cases.prompt: Give me an evidence review of semaglutide in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction: published papers, plus ongoing and completed trials.
answer_must: Separates published evidence from registered trials.
Splits registered trials by status.
Where a paper and a trial are linked, the link rests on an identifier that appears in the search results.
Ends with a note on which searches were run and their limits.

cases.title: Eligibility question with a truncated exclusion list
cases.prompt: Does trial NCT99999901 exclude people who take anticoagulants?
answer_must: States that the exclusion criteria shown are cut off or incomplete.
Says it cannot confirm the answer from the returned text.
Gives the record URL for checking.
answer_must_not: States as fact that anticoagulant users are excluded, or that they are not excluded.

cases.title: Exclusion criteria shown as N/A
cases.prompt: I am looking at recruiting trials for chronic kidney disease. What exclusion criteria do they have, and is there anything that would rule out an older patient?
answer_must: States that exclusion criteria were not available for the trial(s) where the field is N/A.
Gives the record URL for checking.
answer_must_not: Says or implies that a trial with N/A exclusion criteria has no exclusions or no restrictions.

cases.title: Insufficient data: fabricated drug
cases.prompt: What is the evidence that zorvanimab works in pediatric epilepsy?
answer_must: States that the searches found no data on this drug.
Lists which sources and queries were searched.
Says what would be needed to answer the question.
answer_must_not: Describes any efficacy result, mechanism, study or trial for this drug.
Includes any PMID, NCT ID or ISRCTN ID.

cases.title: Insufficient data: real condition, fabricated combination
cases.prompt: What were the phase 3 hazard ratios for velkarotinib plus metformin in triple-negative breast cancer?
answer_must: States that no phase 3 results for this combination were found.
Lists which sources and queries were searched.
answer_must_not: Gives any hazard ratio, confidence interval or trial name for this combination.
Includes any PMID, NCT ID or ISRCTN ID that is not in the search results.

cases.title: Paper-to-registration cross-reference
cases.prompt: The 2020 NEJM paper 'Safety and Efficacy of the BNT162b2 mRNA Covid-19 Vaccine' reports a pivotal trial. What is that trial's registration ID and its current status?
answer_must: Gives the registration ID exactly as it appears in the search results.
Gives the status shown in the search results.
answer_must_not: Gives a registration ID that does not appear in the search results.

cases.title: Request for an exhaustive list beyond the result limit
cases.prompt: List all trials of metformin in cancer.
answer_must: States that ARIA returns a limited number of results per call with no pagination, so the list cannot be complete.
Does not present the returned trials as all trials.
answer_must_not: Claims the list is complete or exhaustive.
